subject: Game Theory
title: Forgiveness in Strategy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Forgiveness in Strategy.

hook.text: Tit-for-tat has a flaw: one misunderstanding triggers endless retaliation between two copies.

buildup.text: An accidental defection starts a cycle: betray, betray, betray—forever. Neither side breaks the loop.

discovery.text: 'Generous tit-for-tat' fixes this by occasionally forgiving a defection and cooperating anyway.

twist.text: Too much forgiveness gets exploited. Too little creates vendettas. The sweet spot is about 10%.

climax.text: Forgiveness isn't weakness in strategy. It's error correction for an imperfect world.

quiz.question: What problem does generous tit-for-tat solve?
